title: Continuity and differentiability in the scale of radial cutoff integrals
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), IntegrableOn f (closedBall y S) μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 0 < T → (∀ u : ℝ, T ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → ContinuousAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * f x ∂μ) t ∧ ContinuousAt (fun s => ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / s * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * f x ∂μ) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * f x ∂μ) (-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * f x ∂μ) / t) t
